info.title: InvoiceHub API
info.description:
GST-compliant invoicing and business management API.

**Role hierarchy:** SuperAdmin → Admin → Manager → Accountant → SalesAgent → Viewer

Authenticate via POST /api/auth/login, then click 'Authorize' and paste your JWT.

Bearer.description:
Paste your JWT access token here.
Example: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...
